ranked.text: A recent production model alias change in service:gridcast:forecast-service caused a model reload and slowed model inference enough to push service:gridcast:forecast-pipeline p95 duration above 5s.
Stale or incomplete input data from service:gridcast:ingestion caused service:gridcast:forecast-pipeline to wait, retry, or run extra validation, increasing p95 duration above 5s.
Elevated database load on service:gridcast:postgres slowed forecast-pipeline database reads and contributed to the p95 duration above 5s.
Forecast-pipeline run failures or retries caused repeated work and therefore elevated p95 duration above 5s.
A recent commit or rollout to service:gridcast:forecast-pipeline or its direct supplier services introduced a slow execution path, producing the observed pipeline p95 above 5s.
